summary: Curry County, OR lookout in the Siskiyou NF, built 1936 or 1937 (sources differ) and removed by 1950. No source read describes the site today.

facts.design: 10-foot redwood tower with a live-in cab (register, firelookout.com)
facts.status_note: Removed in 1950 per the register; firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1950s. The FFLA Oregon list shows it as gone.

events.note: Register and firelookout.com date the 10-foot tower to 1936
Forest Lookouts gives 1937 for the 10-foot tower and lookout cab; conflicts with 1936
Siskiyou National Forest guard-placement plan, quoted by Forest Lookouts: apparently little use, lightning the main risk
Staffed 84 days; reported by radio to the Redwood station
Register: removed in 1950. firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1950s

evidence.supports: built 1936; 10-foot tower made of redwood with a live-in cab
evidence.quote: A 10 foot tower made of Redwood with a live-in cab was constructed on the site in 1936.

evidence.supports: the site is in the Siskiyou National Forest
lookout on a minor point 1.5 miles east-southeast of the prominent summit
evidence.quote: Located atop minor point 1.5 miles ESE of prominent summit.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com: 1936 tower, abandoned in the 1950s, gone
Forest Lookouts: 1937 10-foot tower and lookout cab
evidence.quote: 1937: A 10-foot tower and lookout cab constructed.

evidence.supports: 1940 guard-placement plan: position apparently little used
evidence.quote: Position located in country which apparently does not get much use.

evidence.supports: 1940 guard-placement plan: lightning the chief risk
evidence.quote: Lightning is chief risk and the suggested season is based on this assumption.

evidence.supports: 1941 staffed 84 days, reported to Redwood station by radio
evidence.quote: The lookout station staffed 84 days, reported to the Redwood station by radio.

notes_for_editor: Build year is in conflict: the register and firelookout.com say 1936; Forest Lookouts says 1937. The register's own panorama is captioned 6-25-1935, which predates both, so it is unresolved. Coordinates: the record's FFLOS point (42.136095, -123.93085) and the FFLA/firelookout point (42.1276, -123.91928) are about 1.3 km apart. firelookout.com places the tower on a minor point 1.5 miles ESE of the prominent summit, so the FFLA point may be the summit; unverified. Photo lead, not used: an Oregon Explorer catalog entry titled 'Chetco fire lookout site' (photograph by Rene Casteran, Forest Service, dated 1968) turned up in search. The catalog record gives no image URL and does not say what the picture shows. Reads: register, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts, Oregon Explorer catalog, FFLA Oregon list (shared); 2 WebSearch.
